June 29, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Seaward Management Limited Partnership increased its stake in Merck & Co Inc (MRK) by 45.29% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Seaward Management Limited Partnership bought 170,631 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.40% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 547,363 shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $29.81M, up from 376,732 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Seaward Management Limited Partnership who had been investing in Merck & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $162.23B market cap company.
